+    description: Wait until every selected drive completes the upgrade.
+    type: bool

+    description: Skip inaccessible drives instead of failing.
+    type: bool
+    default: false
+  upgrade_drives_online:
+    description: Upgrade drives while they accept I/O. Requires online upgrade support.
+    type: bool
+    default: true
+notes:
+  - Check mode reports drives that require an upgrade without uploading or upgrading firmware.
+'''
+
+EXAMPLES = '''
+- name: Upgrade E-Series drive firmware
+  netapp_e_drive_firmware:
+    api_url: https://array.example.com:8443
+    api_username: admin
+    api_password: "{{ password }}"
+    ssid: '1'
+    firmware:
+      - /tmp/drive_firmware.dlp
+    wait_for_completion: true
+'''
+

+changed:
+  description: Whether any compatible drive requires a firmware upgrade.
+  type: bool
+  returned: always

+  description: Whether an initiated upgrade is still in progress.
+  type: bool
+  returned: always

+import time

+from ansible.module_utils.netapp import NetAppESeriesModule, create_multipart_formdata
+
+
+WAIT_TIMEOUT_SEC = 3600
+POLL_INTERVAL_SEC = 5
+PENDING_STATUSES = ('inProgress', 'inProgressRecon', 'pending', 'notAttempted')
+
+

+        super(NetAppESeriesDriveFirmware, self).__init__(dict(
+            firmware=dict(type='list', elements='str', required=True),
+            wait_for_completion=dict(type='bool', default=False),
+            ignore_inaccessible_drives=dict(type='bool', default=False),
+            upgrade_drives_online=dict(type='bool', default=True),
+        ), supports_check_mode=True)

+        self.wait_for_completion = params['wait_for_completion']
+        self.ignore_inaccessible_drives = params['ignore_inaccessible_drives']

+        self.upgrade_in_progress = False

+

+            return

+                self.request('files/drive', data=body, method='POST', headers=headers)
+            except Exception as err:
+                self.module.fail_json(msg='Failed to upload drive firmware %s to array %s: %s' %
+                                          (path, self.ssid, to_native(err)))
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _entries(payload):
+        if isinstance(payload, list):
+            return payload
+        for key in ('files', 'compatibilities', 'driveFirmwareCompatibilities', 'firmware'):
+            if isinstance(payload.get(key), list):
+                return payload[key]
+        return []
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _drive_refs(entry):
+        refs = entry.get('driveRefList', entry.get('driveRefs', entry.get('drives', [])))
+        if isinstance(refs, dict):
+            refs = refs.get('driveRef', [])
+        return refs
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _online_capable(record):
+        for name in ('onlineUpgradeCapable', 'isOnlineUpgradeCapable', 'onlineUpgrade'):
+            if name in record:
+                return record[name]
+        return None
+

+        if self._upgrade_list is not None:
+            return self._upgrade_list
+        try:
+            _, payload = self.request(self._path(''))

+        except Exception as err:
+            self.module.fail_json(msg='Failed to complete compatibility and health check. Array %s: %s' %

+        selected = []

+            for entry in matches:

+                    drive_ref = candidate.get('driveRef') if isinstance(candidate, dict) else candidate

+                    try:

+                    except Exception as err:
+                        self.module.fail_json(msg='Failed to retrieve drive information. Drive %s on array %s: %s' %

+    main()

+from ansible.modules.storage.netapp.netapp_e_drive_firmware import NetAppESeriesDriveFirmware
+from units.compat import mock
+from units.modules.utils import AnsibleExitJson, AnsibleFailJson, ModuleTestCase, set_module_args
+
+
+class DriveFirmwareTest(ModuleTestCase):
+    def make_module(self, **options):
+        args = dict(api_url='https://localhost', api_username='admin', api_password='secret',
+                    ssid='1', firmware=['/tmp/model.dlp'])
+        args.update(options)
+        set_module_args(args)
+        return NetAppESeriesDriveFirmware()
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def responses(path, **kwargs):
+        if path.endswith('/firmware/drives'):
+            return 200, [dict(filename='model.dlp', firmwareVersion='2.0',
+                              driveRefList=['a', 'b'])]
+        if path.endswith('/drives/a'):
+            return 200, dict(firmwareVersion='1.0', status='optimal', onlineUpgradeCapable=True)
+        if path.endswith('/drives/b'):
+            return 200, dict(firmwareVersion='2.0', status='optimal', onlineUpgradeCapable=True)
+        raise AssertionError(path)
+
+    def test_upgrade_list_selects_only_outdated_compatible_drives(self):
+        firmware = self.make_module()
+        with mock.patch.object(firmware, 'request', side_effect=self.responses) as request:
+            expected = [dict(filename='model.dlp', driveRefList=['a'])]
+            self.assertEqual(firmware.upgrade_list(), expected)
+            self.assertEqual(firmware.upgrade_list(), expected)
+            self.assertEqual(request.call_count, 3)
+
+    def test_check_mode_reports_change_without_writing(self):
+        firmware = self.make_module(_ansible_check_mode=True)
+        with mock.patch.object(firmware, 'request', side_effect=self.responses) as request:
+            with self.assertRaises(AnsibleExitJson) as result:
+                firmware.apply()
+        self.assertTrue(result.exception.args[0]['changed'])
+        self.assertFalse(result.exception.args[0]['upgrade_in_process'])
+        self.assertEqual(request.call_count, 3)
+
+    def test_online_upgrade_rejects_incapable_drive(self):
+        firmware = self.make_module()
+
+        def responses(path, **kwargs):
+            rc, payload = self.responses(path, **kwargs)
+            if path.endswith('/drives/a'):
+                payload['onlineUpgradeCapable'] = False
+            return rc, payload
+
+        with mock.patch.object(firmware, 'request', side_effect=responses):
+            with self.assertRaises(AnsibleFailJson) as result:
+                firmware.upgrade_list()
+        self.assertIn('Drive is not capable of online upgrade.', result.exception.args[0]['msg'])
+
+    def test_wait_checks_only_selected_drives(self):
+        firmware = self.make_module()
+        firmware._upgrade_list = [dict(filename='model.dlp', driveRefList=['a'])]
+        firmware.upgrade_in_progress = True
+        with mock.patch.object(firmware, 'request', return_value=(200, [
+                dict(driveRef='a', status='okay'), dict(driveRef='other', status='failed')])):
+            firmware.wait_for_upgrade_completion()
+        self.assertFalse(firmware.upgrade_in_progress)
+
+    def test_wait_fails_on_selected_drive_error(self):
+        firmware = self.make_module()
+        firmware._upgrade_list = [dict(filename='model.dlp', driveRefList=['a'])]
+        with mock.patch.object(firmware, 'request', return_value=(200, [dict(driveRef='a', status='failed')])):
+            with self.assertRaises(AnsibleFailJson) as result:
+                firmware.wait_for_upgrade_completion()
+        self.assertIn('Drive firmware upgrade failed.', result.exception.args[0]['msg'])
+
+    def test_upgrade_uses_selected_drives_and_offline_flag(self):
+        firmware = self.make_module(upgrade_drives_online=False)
+        firmware._upgrade_list = [dict(filename='model.dlp', driveRefList=['a'])]
+        with mock.patch.object(firmware, 'request', return_value=(202, {})) as request:
+            firmware.upgrade()
+        args, kwargs = request.call_args
+        self.assertTrue(args[0].endswith('/firmware/drives/initiate-upgrade'))
+        self.assertEqual(kwargs['data']['upgradeList'], firmware._upgrade_list)
+        self.assertFalse(kwargs['data']['online'])
+        self.assertTrue(firmware.upgrade_in_progress)
+
+    def test_upload_failure_identifies_file_and_array(self):
+        firmware = self.make_module()
+        with mock.patch('ansible.modules.storage.netapp.netapp_e_drive_firmware.create_multipart_formdata',
+                        side_effect=IOError('missing file')):
+            with self.assertRaises(AnsibleFailJson) as result:
+                firmware.upload_firmware()
+        self.assertIn('Failed to upload drive firmware', result.exception.args[0]['msg'])
+        self.assertIn('/tmp/model.dlp', result.exception.args[0]['msg'])
+        self.assertIn('array 1', result.exception.args[0]['msg'])
+
+    def test_wait_times_out_when_target_is_missing(self):
+        firmware = self.make_module()
+        firmware._upgrade_list = [dict(filename='model.dlp', driveRefList=['a'])]
+        with mock.patch.object(firmware, 'request', return_value=(200, [])):
+            with mock.patch('ansible.modules.storage.netapp.netapp_e_drive_firmware.time.time',
+                            side_effect=[0, 3600]):
+                with self.assertRaises(AnsibleFailJson) as result:
+                    firmware.wait_for_upgrade_completion()
+        self.assertIn('Timed out waiting for drive firmware upgrade.', result.exception.args[0]['msg'])

+                ref = state.get('driveRef')
+                if ref not in refs:
+                    continue
+                seen.add(ref)
+                status = state.get('status', state.get('upgradeStatus'))
+                if status != 'okay' and status not in PENDING_STATUSES:
+                    self.module.fail_json(msg='Drive firmware upgrade failed. Drive %s on array %s: %s' %
+                                              (ref, self.ssid, status))
+            if seen == refs and all(state.get('status', state.get('upgradeStatus')) == 'okay'
+                                    for state in states if state.get('driveRef') in refs):
+                self.upgrade_in_progress = False
+                return
+            if time.time() >= deadline:
+                self.module.fail_json(msg='Timed out waiting for drive firmware upgrade. Array %s.' % self.ssid)
+            time.sleep(POLL_INTERVAL_SEC)
+
+    def upgrade(self):
+        upgrades = self.upgrade_list()
+        if not upgrades:
+            return
+        try:
+            self.request(self._path('/initiate-upgrade'), data=dict(
+                upgradeList=upgrades, online=self.upgrade_drives_online), method='POST')
+        except Exception as err:
+            self.module.fail_json(msg='Failed to upgrade drive firmware. Array %s: %s' %
+                                      (self.ssid, to_native(err)))
+        self.upgrade_in_progress = True
+        if self.wait_for_completion:
+            self.wait_for_upgrade_completion()
+
+    def apply(self):
+        self.upload_firmware()
+        upgrades = self.upgrade_list()
+        if upgrades and not self.module.check_mode:
+            self.upgrade()
+        self.module.exit_json(changed=bool(upgrades), upgrade_in_process=self.upgrade_in_progress)
+
+
+def main():
+    NetAppESeriesDriveFirmware().apply()
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()

+                    ssid='1', firmware=['/tmp/model.dlp'])

+        set_module_args(args)

+    @staticmethod

+        if path.endswith('/drives/a'):

+            expected = [dict(filename='model.dlp', driveRefList=['a'])]
+            self.assertEqual(firmware.upgrade_list(), expected)
+            self.assertEqual(firmware.upgrade_list(), expected)
+            self.assertEqual(request.call_count, 3)
